scope_outcomes.criterion: A finding must identify an explicit concession, limitation or qualification and show how the text responds to it and what claim it narrows or preserves.
scope_outcomes.basis: The inspected sections contain explicit qualifications concerning capitalism’s destructive effects, religion’s rationalizing contributions, capitalism’s inability to answer ultimate religious questions, its material performance, and the open society’s mixed consequences.
limitations: The assessment concerns the supplied text and its cited positions; it does not compare the argument with uncited earlier works or establish the authors’ intentions.

evidence_state.coverage_basis: reader/reviewer report; source bytes do not establish inspection or completeness
blocking_issues: One or more declared finding references lack retained verified evidence
